decisions.reason: The large bulk container sits close to the firm's core reusable-packaging knowledge and is featured on its own page, so the firm can readily interpret early market feedback and refine it through in-house R&D.
The valve is a component that builds on the firm's established bulk-container engineering, where existing design expertise gives it strong capacity to learn from use and improve the product.

The take-back service fits the firm's move toward circular, service-based offers and draws on its pooling and supply-chain operations, but its thinner web presence and service rather than product nature make its early results harder to read, which leaves a moderate risk of discontinuation.
